column1: Revocation  of Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS  by order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (Revised
Edition 1956) as amended by Acts, No. 14 and 62  of 1957, 14 of  1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes(Special Provisions)
Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 03.05.2019 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extra-Ordinary No.
2122/45 dated 09.05.2019 the Industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement  of the Commissioner of Labour dated
01.  Mr.  K.P.Pemasiri,  Pinikahana,  Kahadowa  02.  Mr.  B.A.  Dharmasena  Jayantha,  No.  32/A9,    Wickramage  Mawatha,
Brahmanagama, Pannipitiya"  of the one part
and
1.  Mr.  Nimal    Priyarathna  (President),  2.  Mr. Avancka  Herath  (Captain),  3.  Mr.  Nalin  Jayathilake  (General  Manager),
4. W.A.K.Fernando (Vice Captain), 5. Mr. Naveen de Silva (Infrastructure and Club, House Development Secretary), 6. Mr. Sanjeewa
Wickramanayake (Ground Secretary), 7. Mr. Suren Madanayake (F and B  Secretary), 8. Mr. Saneth Gamage (Treasurer) 9. Mr. Wasantha
De Silva (Marcom Secretary), Royal Colombo  Golf Club, No. 223, Model Farm Road, Colombo 08.  of the other part
was referred to Mr. S.G.Sooriyaarachchi  for settlement by arbitration.
AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour, Trade Union
Relations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 03.05.2019.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,
Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo,
04th  November, 2019.
